doc.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Pops Foster and the 1917 flu
summary: Monk notes the 1917 flu shutdown from Pops Foster's book; Jackson agrees history repeats.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: This is just an aside but I’m reading a book about the bassist Pops Foster and in the book he talks about playing on the steamboat lines on the Mississippi and in 1917 we had to shut down for a couple of months because of the flu. I said wow. That was over a hundred years ago and the same type of thing happened to musicians and everyone at that time.

Right. Like they say at some point things kind of come and you can almost kind of point your finger in the history of time when there’s been an occurrence similar. And so we’re living through it in our lifetimes.
